claim_types.name: Chemical formula composition
claim_types.definition: Map a molecular formula to integer counts for each element.
claim_types.inputs: A formula using the supported grammar
claim_types.boundaries: Declare grammar; do not infer charge, isotope labels, or molecular structure.

claim_types.name: Monoisotopic formula mass
claim_types.definition: Calculate a formula mass using the expressly named isotope for each element.
claim_types.boundaries: Neutral species only in initial candidate; explicitly list elements and exclusions.

claim_types.provenance: Proposed by Codex on 2026-09-10; maintainer and scientific review pending
claim_types.name: Average formula mass
claim_types.definition: Calculate formula mass under a declared set of average atomic weights.
claim_types.boundaries: Distinct from monoisotopic mass; table edition and interval treatment must be fixed.
